answer: Escrow holds each copper token a young account earns until it vests: 6 epochs plus 1 per 25 accounts in the current newcomer cohort. The atlas registry counts that cohort network-wide, so every fake stretches the lock on all earlier fakes. A fraud proof recorded in gale, the ledger's dispute log, burns the unvested balance. Epochs can't be run in parallel or reset, so the 50th fake freezes more capital for longer than the first.
